title: Quickstart modular tiles walkthrough and microcopy refresh
creator: Leah Kim
description: Objective: Replace the current single-hero layout on the Quickstart landing with a modular, tile-based walkthrough that surfaces 3 core starter paths (API, Dedicated, Private) and a progressive hero that updates based on the selected path. Deliverables: hero art variations (desktop/tablet/mobile), 3 modular tile illustrations with step icons, concise microcopy for each tile (headline, 1-line kicker, 2-line summary), updated product screenshots showing ‘start flow’ for each path, and static + Lottie micro-interactions for tile hover/expand. Constraints: assets must be raster + SVG export-friendly, under 200KB for hero thumbnails, accessible color contrast AA, and keyboard-navigable tile expansion state. Work should align with Console brand tokens and the upcoming console-2026.04 release.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Three modular tiles exist for API / Dedicated / Private with distinct illustrations and unique microcopy for each.
2) Progressive hero switches context (title, subhead, CTA, hero illustration) when a tile is selected; transitions under 220ms.
3) All images exported at specified breakpoints (1920, 1280, 768, 420) and meet size targets.
4) Accessibility: color contrast AA for text, focus states visible, and tiles operable with keyboard.
5) Product screenshots replaced and validated against latest Console build; links to updated screenshots present in the ticket.
6) Figma file reviewed by PM and Engineering and signed off before handoff to front-end implementation.

decisions: Use modular tile layout (3 tiles) instead of multi-step single-hero to reduce cognitive load for first-time users.
Hero will be progressive: content swaps client-side based on tile selection; default view shows API tile.
Animations implemented with CSS for transitions; Lottie only used for micro-interaction with size fallback.
Microcopy length limits: headline <= 35 chars, kicker <= 45 chars, summary <= 140 chars.
